metadata.title: मणिपुर: कब तक रिलीफ़ कैंप में जिएँगे | Manipur: Realty Of A Relief Camp
metadata.description:
For the past three months, the state of Manipur in India has been grappling with escalating ethnic violence, leading to a pervasive atmosphere of fear and mistrust among its residents. The conflict has primarily involved the Kuki and Meitei communities, deepening the divide between them. As the violence continues, the social fabric of the region is strained, prompting concerns about the long-term consequences and the urgent need for peace-building measures and reconciliation efforts.
#manipur
